entities.summary: Justin Lee Tuck is an American former professional football player who was a defensive end in the National Football League (NFL). He played college football at Notre Dame, and was selected by the New York Giants in the third round of the 2005 NFL draft, winning two Super Bowl titles with the team. He also played for the Oakland Raiders. Tuck graduated from the University of Pennsylvania's Wharton School of Business with an MBA in 2018, and was employed by Goldman Sachs.
